items.followUp: Write two properties of ionic compounds.

rubric.why: A characteristic physical property of covalent compounds is required.
rubric.description: States that covalent compounds generally have low melting points.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that covalent compounds generally have low melting points.

rubric.why: A second distinct characteristic property completes the response.
rubric.description: States that covalent compounds are poor conductors of electricity.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that covalent compounds are poor conductors of electricity.

modelAnswer: Covalent compounds generally have low melting and boiling points.
They are poor conductors of electricity.

rubric.why: The definition must identify the change of state involved in freezing.
rubric.description: Identifies the change from liquid to solid.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a liquid changes into a solid.

rubric.why: The definition must specify the temperature and pressure conditions for the change.
rubric.description: States that freezing occurs at a definite temperature at constant pressure.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the change occurs at a particular temperature under constant pressure.

modelAnswer: The freezing point is the temperature at which a liquid changes into a solid.
This change occurs at a constant pressure.
